prompt: Backorder handling has two bugs. `receive()` skips any backorder it can't fill completely and hands the stock to later, smaller ones instead -- it must be strictly first-come-first-served per SKU: the oldest open backorder takes as much as is available (partial fills are fine, the rest stays at the front of the queue) and nothing goes to anyone behind it until it's fully filled. `cancel_order()` only puts the order's reserved units back into free stock and leaves its backorders open, so later receipts get reserved for a dead order -- it has to close the cancelled order's open backorders and offer the released units to the backorders waiting for that SKU (same FIFO rules, units stay in the warehouse they were released from) before whatever is left goes back to free stock.
